scope: Investigation only. The shipped dist assets and normal saved circuits were not edited. Experiments are opt-in on the isolated localhost:8783 diagnostic server.

workload.input: Synthetic mouse pan handler and wheel-zoom handler, not a physical mouse latency test

findings: Wire visual rendering is the dominant measured component in this dense region: suppressing only wire visuals, while retaining their DOM, hit paths and electrical model, reduced pan and mixed pan/zoom medians to 16.7 ms. This was a diagnostic ablation, not a shippable fix.
Suppressing board visuals did not reduce the 33.3 ms median. Optimizing board art first is not supported by these results.
Removing the world will-change hint worsened zoom. Keep the existing hint; do not assume fewer compositor layers is automatically better.
Moving the same wire SVG into a screen-sized sibling layer with a camera viewBox did not help. It retained all 14531 paths and original filters but caused more camera-dependent drawing work.
This narrows the bottleneck to wire rendering; it does not identify exact browser raster, paint or compositor internals. No browser GPU trace was captured.
Previous full-frame Canvas redraw experiments were not reliably faster. A renderer replacement is not justified without a changed caching strategy and visual/editing parity tests.

recommendedNextExperiment.approach: A tile-cached wire drawing prototype, outside dist, rather than repainting every visible wire on every camera frame.
recommendedNextExperiment.cacheKey: Geometry revision, wire appearance and signal revision, tile coordinates, scale and device pixel ratio
recommendedNextExperiment.camera: Move cached image regions for pan; refresh exposed regions and appropriate zoom-resolution tiles. Preserve crisp final zoom rendering.
recommendedNextExperiment.signals: Invalidate and redraw affected regions on actual signal changes. Never freeze simulation or knowingly retain stale lit wires.
recommendedNextExperiment.editing: Keep original SVG selection/hit geometry, junctions, crossing order, bend and endpoint handles. Update geometry caches for edits, undo, import and project switches.
acceptance: Repeat original and cached runs in front and back areas without concurrent tests, measuring median, p95 and long stalls
Verify raster appearance across zoom levels, device pixel ratios, crossing bumps, neon, glow, selection and tile seams
Test active calculator calculations, timed signal loops and immediate signal visibility during pan
Test mouse and touch pan/zoom, wire selection, bends, endpoints, dragging, resize, undo and saved-project restoration
No circuit-size limits, removed features or production changes
recommendedNextExperiment.status: Recommended, not implemented or proven faster

caveats: Small controlled samples on one in-app browser. No universal FPS or mobile-device guarantee. Normal preview was found stopped and restarted on localhost:8781. All ablation styles were reset to original before cleanup.
